title: Realistic rebuild: Betsy, Mothron and the Martian Saucer
player_outcome: Betsy is a proper winged dragon that beats its wings, Mothron a furred moth with dusty flapping wings, and the Martian Saucer a gleaming disc with a pilot dome, turrets and a glowing ring.
design: betsy: metaball dragon body, horned head, rigged wings with a flap clip, ember glow in the throat.
mothron: fuzzy body via detail strands or shells, patterned wings with a flap clip, compound eyes.
martian_saucer: a lathe-turned disc, glass dome with an alien pilot (reuse a critter/humanoid-lite mesh), 4 turret models for future parts, glow ring.
verification: Preview sheets and boss gallery screenshots
risks: Translucent wing materials must use prop:*:clear slots and stay cheap on the low preset (no shadows from wings).
